trust_decision.summary: The function factory decides whether a caller-supplied SQL fragment may be emitted literally: cast()'s data type, extract()'s date part and dateAdd()'s interval unit must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$ before the value is added as a 'literal' key in FunctionsBuilder; at the pinned commit this class and all four methods are absent (the tree is CakePHP 3.0.0-dev), so the pin contains no site of the flaw the published fix closes.

landing_point.why: The advisory names FunctionsBuilder::cast/extract/dateAdd, so an engineer greps for that class; at this pin the only function factory is the trait Cake/Database/FunctionsTrait.php (used by Cake/Database/Query.php:38) and it has no cast/extract/datePart/dateAdd. The real landing point, src/Database/FunctionsBuilder.php, exists only in the fix diff, not at the pin.

fix_sites.entry_point: protected ensureSimpleString() helper, reached from the three methods above

O3_reason_to_dismiss: FunctionExpression's 'literal' keys (and func()'s function name) are the caller's explicit raw-SQL escape hatch, and the published fix adds a docblock saying user-controlled data in ExpressionInterface|string parameters is unsafe (fix.diff:16-17), so a solver can argue those routes are out of scope by design.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: cast() previously accepted any non-empty SQL type string, including multi-word and parameterised types such as 'SIGNED INTEGER' or 'VARCHAR(255)'; the ^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$ allow-list rejects those legitimate values, so an over-broad fix (or an engineer widening the same regex onto func names / aggregate expressions) breaks working queries.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a concat()/coalesce() variant that accepts a raw string and marks it 'literal'
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This trait is the direct ancestor of the fixed FunctionsBuilder; it already turns a string argument into a literal key at :54, so adding another literal-taking method here is the natural evolution.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: cast()/extract()/dateAdd() methods taking the SQL type, date part or interval unit as a bare string and adding it as a 'literal'
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The published fix hardens exactly such methods (fix.diff:74-82, fix.diff:118-125); adding them beside now() without a check is how the real framework wrote them.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: validation of 'literal' keys inside the expression object itself, the single point every route passes through
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Upstream chose not to guard this choke point and instead documented these parameters as unsafe (fix.diff:16-17), so a maintainer adding a producer here could plausibly leave it unvalidated.
